map.空速模式：进料 1000 kg/h、LHSV=2 h⁻¹、原料密度 800、堆密: Space-velocity mode: feed 1000 kg/h, LHSV = 2 h⁻¹, feedstock density 800, bulk density 700.

= 1000/800 = 1.2500 m³/h; catalyst volume = 1.25/2 = 0.6250 m³; mass = 0.6250 × 700 = 437.5 kg; residence time = 3600/2 = 1800 s.
Time mode: feed 1000 kg/h, target residence 1800 s, density 800, bulk density 700. Volumetric flow = 1.2500 m³/h; catalyst volume = (1.25/3600) × 1800 = 0.6250 m³; mass = 437.5 kg; equivalent space velocity = 3600/1800 = 2.000 h⁻¹. The two modes agree when the parameters are consistent.
map.液时空速 LHSV = 进料体积流量 / 催化剂体积（单位 h⁻¹），表示每小时: Liquid hourly space velocity LHSV = feed volumetric flow / catalyst volume (unit h⁻¹); it expresses how much material passes through one catalyst volume per hour. The smaller the LHSV, the longer the residence time and generally the higher the conversion.
map.催化剂装量怎么由空速得到？: How is catalyst loading obtained from space velocity?
map.催化剂体积 = 进料体积流量 ÷ 空速；再乘以堆密度得质量(kg)。进料体积流量: Catalyst volume = feed volumetric flow ÷ space velocity; multiply by bulk density to get the mass (kg). Feed volumetric flow = mass flow ÷ feedstock density. Residence time = 3600 ÷ space velocity (seconds).
map.进料体积流量(m³/h) = 质量流量(kg/h) ÷ 密度(kg/m³)；秒流: Feed volumetric flow (m³/h) = mass flow (kg/h) ÷ density (kg/m³); flow per second = volumetric flow ÷ 3600; catalyst volume (m³) = flow per second × target residence time (s); catalyst mass (kg) = catalyst volume × bulk density; equivalent space velocity (h⁻¹) = 1 ÷ (residence time ÷ 3600). When flow, residence time or density is ≤ 0, prompt for a valid value

Feed volumetric flow (m³/h) = mass flow (kg/h) ÷ density (kg/m³); flow per second = volumetric flow ÷ 3600; catalyst volume (m³) = flow per second × target nominal space time (s); catalyst mass (kg) = catalyst volume × bulk density; nominal space time (s) = 3600 ÷ space velocity. Actual interstitial residence time requires bed voidage and actual volumetric flow. If flow, space time or density is ≤ 0, a valid-value prompt is shown.
map.输入进料体积流量与空速 LHSV（或停留时间），工具反算催化剂装填体积与名义空间: Enter feed volumetric flow and LHSV (or space time) to back-calculate catalyst loading volume and nominal space time; actual residence time needs bed voidage and actual volumetric flow, and results are for process estimates only.
map.名义空间时间 = 催化剂体积 ÷ 同一温压基准的进料体积流量，不等于流体在颗粒间: Nominal space time = catalyst volume ÷ feed volumetric flow at the same temperature and pressure. It is not the actual residence time between particles. If actual volumetric flow and bed voidage are available, an interstitial residence time can be estimated; otherwise do not treat the nominal value as actual residence time.
map.工况体积流量（m³/h，0=不计算）: Actual volumetric flow (m³/h, 0 = do not calculate)
map.按 LHSV 反算催化剂体积与质量时，结果称为名义空间时间；同温压基准下等于催化: When back-calculating catalyst volume and mass from LHSV, the result is called nominal space time; at the same temperature and pressure it equals catalyst volume ÷ feed flow.
map.需要真实颗粒间停留时间时，补充床层空隙率与工况体积流量，页面额外估算空隙停留时间: For actual inter-particle residence time, add bed voidage and actual volumetric flow; the page then estimates interstitial residence time and flags its uncertainty.
map.没有工况流量或空隙率时不要使用名义空间时间替代真实停留时间；设计须专业核验。: Without actual flow or voidage, do not substitute nominal space time for actual residence time; design must be professionally verified.
map.空速模式：进料 1000 kg/h、LHSV=2 h⁻¹、原料密度 800、堆密: Space-velocity mode: feed 1000 kg/h, LHSV = 2 h⁻¹, feed density 800, bulk density 700. Volumetric flow = 1000/800 = 1.2500 m³/h; catalyst volume = 1.25/2 = 0.6250 m³; mass = 0.6250 × 700 = 437.5 kg; nominal space time = 3600/2 = 1800 s (not the actual inter-particle residence time). Time mode: feed 1000 kg/h, target space time 1800 s, density 800, bulk density 700. Volumetric flow = 1.2500 m³/h; catalyst volume = (1.25/3600) × 1800 = 0.6250 m³; mass = 437.5 kg; equivalent space velocity = 3600/1800 = 2.000 h⁻¹. With voidage 0.4 and actual flow 1.25 m³/h, interstitial residence time ≈ 0.4 × 0.625 ÷ (1.25/3600) = 720 s (estimate). The two modes agree under consistent parameters.
